    Professional experience

    PhD Candidate & Machine Learning Research Engineer

    Inria Lyon · CHASER and INSTINCT collaborative projects
    March 2024 - February 2027 · Lyon area, France

    • Design self-supervised methods that transform high-dimensional radio measurements into spatial and dynamic representations for pseudo-localisation and future channel-state anticipation.
    • Build reproducible Python/PyTorch pipelines for data preparation, training, evaluation, ablation studies and visualisation on Grid'5000 and Jean Zay HPC systems.
    • Study channel-chart robustness under reconfigurable intelligent surfaces and develop invariant methods for radio mapping and control tasks.
    • Deliver a multi-cell dataset with generator/simulator and source code, channel-charting applications and API, privacy analysis and protection mechanisms.
    • Report progress to project partners, produce technical documentation and publish results in international conferences.

    Machine Learning R&D Engineer · Transfer Learning

    TotalEnergies OneTech
    March 2023 - September 2023 · Palaiseau, France

    • Led a transfer-learning study for multi-horizon wind-power forecasting across wind farms with heterogeneous data distributions.
    • Conducted the literature review, time-series preparation, comparative experiments and interpretation.
    • Presented findings to R&D teams during Mathias Days.

    Machine Learning R&D Intern

    ResilEyes Therapeutics
